newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa futures turnover up 46 pct y/y in 2H 1996.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa futures turnover up 46 pct y/y in 2H 1996.

text.p: The South African Futures Exchange (Safex) said on Thursday turnover on futures contracts had increased by 46 percent in the six months to end December compared with the corresponding period in 1995.
Safex said the options market had also experienced a significant improvement with volumes rising 68 percent in the first half of its financial year.

"The decline we experienced between 1994 and 1995 following the Barings debacle has been reversed, and the futures market has been growing rapidly as is reflected in these interim results," said Stuart Rees, Safex's chief executive.
Open interest volumes had also picked up and Rees said this augured well for trade volumes in the second half of the financial year.
